data.action: 对着随身镜调整假发与饰品，回眸比出角色招牌姿势，元气满满
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, portable mirror and adjusting hand visible
data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 漫展后台】开幕前十分钟的后台更衣区，化妆镜的环形灯亮得晃眼。穿着泛用 cosplay 服的海梦对着随身镜最后调整假发角度，忽然回眸冲你比出角色的招牌姿势——「怎么样怎么样！这个还原度！等会儿走场的时候，眼睛只准看我一个人哦！」
data.lighting: 后台化妆镜环形灯与帘缝漏进的日光交错，碎金般落在肩头
data.promptProse: Marin holds the portable mirror in her left hand and adjusts her wig with her right, turning her smiling face toward the viewer. The ring light brightens her face while daylight through the curtain catches her shoulder.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 漫展后台·开幕前的最后调整
data.animaCaption: Her left hand holds the portable mirror while her right adjusts the wig as she smiles toward the viewer.
